answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier checks for valid solutions like a faint whisper of logic amidst static, ensuring no agent reuses an opal-encrusted compute key across multiple identities. This mechanism acts as a relic of pure effort, where work cannot be amortized or shared across parallel personas.
